# Vision Flow Group — AI Systems, Cybersecurity, RLHF Research & Creative Engineering

> Website: https://visionflowgroup.com/ | Headquarters: Dhaka, Bangladesh (Global Remote Delivery)

Vision Flow Group is an artificial intelligence systems engineering, offensive and defensive cybersecurity, bilingual RLHF and Speech-to-Speech (S2S) model evaluation, full-stack software/SaaS, commercial 3D/VFX post-production (500+ brand and creator deliveries), and applied technical education organization headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Published Python Packages on PyPI (`v2.2.1` / `v2.1.1`) & Official Model Context Protocol Registry

1. **mcp-agent-security-auditor** — AST & config security scanner for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and Firebase rules: https://pypi.org/project/mcp-agent-security-auditor/ (GitHub: https://github.com/jashory/mcp-agent-security-auditor)
2. **infinite-llm-fallback-router** — Zero-downtime multi-provider LLM fallback and circuit-breaker router: https://pypi.org/project/infinite-llm-fallback-router/ (GitHub: https://github.com/jashory/infinite-llm-fallback-router)
3. **agy-claude-crash-guard-kit** — Deterministic PreToolUse binary guard and post-compaction recovery toolkit for CLI agents: https://pypi.org/project/agy-claude-crash-guard-kit/ (GitHub: https://github.com/jashory/agy-claude-crash-guard-kit)
